messages:
mira: Heads-up: planning a micro-recognition pop-up at the offsite on Jul 9. Idea: nominate-on-the-spot + instant $25 e-gifts + a tiny enamel pin pickup. Need quick owners for vendor, shipping for remote, and volunteer shifts.

sam: I can own vendor outreach for e-gifts and pins. Will shortlist 3 vendors by end of week.

owen: Happy to handle shipping logistics for remote folks. Will need final addresses by Jul 2.

tess: Payroll check: small awards still need to be logged. For contractors we need written consent; employees will be recorded as taxable benefits. I'll confirm exact phrasing to include on the signup form.

peopleops-bot: REMINDER: Submit vendor invoices by 2025-07-04 17:00 PT to appear in July expense run.

alexa: For the kiosk flow, recommend 20-min shifts, 3 volunteers total (setup, midday, teardown). I can do teardown.

mira: Nice. Can someone draft a 1-line nomination prompt for the form?

sam: Draft prompt: "Who are you recognizing and why? (one sentence)". Add checkbox: "Send $25 spot award" and shipping fields if remote.

tess: I'll add payroll consent language: "I confirm I have manager approval if required; I consent to shipping info being used for award fulfillment."

owen: I'll create a paste-ready shipping template for the form.

mira: Action list: sam (vendors by 6/27), owen (shipping template by 6/28), tess (payroll copy by 6/29), alexa (volunteer schedule). Meet quick sync Jun 30 to confirm. Thanks! :sparkles:
